direction_convention: Screen-space compass labels. World vectors below use the established 45-degree projected camera; do not interpret screen U as world +Z.

selection.facing_input: Quantize cursor direction relative to the character to eight screen-space sectors.
selection.travel_input: Quantize nonzero WASD movement independently in the same screen-space convention.
selection.zero_travel: Use existing eight-way idle assets; idle files are outside this locomotion index.
selection.clip_lookup: Exact facing + travel pair; no mirroring, angle aliases or backward replay.
selection.phase: Preserve normalized cycle phase across clip changes. All cycles last 40 ticks at 60 Hz; use per-frame start/hold ticks, since existing forward D/DL use nonuniform holds.
selection.rendering: Use the selected clip canvas, pivot and approximate PPU. Do not assume identical source density.
selection.integration_status: Asset metadata only; game code has not been wired or engine-tested.

packages.delivery: Parent-verified Drive upload receipt; local archive SHA256 recorded.
